datafield.subfield: [poem and artist's book by] Julie Chen
13 x 251 cm accordion folded to 13 x 9 cm

"Designed and printed by Julie Chen using an assortment of letterpress techniques. Papers include Wyndstone Mica and Tuxedo bronze, found aeronautical charts, and embossed paper designed by Margaret Ahrens Sahlstrand at Icosa Studio. Produced in an edition of 75 copies"--Colophon in box.

Nested accordion book with boards at both ends covered with paper embossed to resemble lizard skin. Low relief gold-colored plastic sunburst medallion glued to the front board. Title collaged on front board. In cloth-covered box (28 x 10 x 6 cm.)--with hinged glass lid. Book images are carried into the box. Signed by the artist.
